name: Minguki Site Backup and Migration
author: mingukisystems

sections.description:
Minguki Site Backup and Migration is engineered for freelancers, agencies, and WordPress site owners who need an effortless, reliable migration solution without arbitrary upload limits, server timeout headaches, or predatory pricing schemes.

Export your entire site — database, media files, active themes, and plugins — into a single portable .nofusswp archive with zero configuration.

Highlights

  • 100% Free Backup Creation & Restore: Create single-file .nofusswp archives and restore complete WordPress sites with zero arbitrary paywalls.
  • Chunked Migration Engine: Slices MySQL database dumps and media archives into lightweight batches, eliminating PHP memory exhaustion and HTTP 504 timeouts.
  • Recursive Serialized Search & Replace: Automatically updates database URLs across wp_options, wp_posts, and wp_postmeta, recalculating exact PHP serialized string lengths (s:N:) to ensure menus, widgets, and page builder layouts remain 100% intact.
  • Direct Download & Chunked Uploader: Download archives straight to your computer or upload archives directly into your destination WordPress site with automatic chunking.
  • Clean & Modern UI: Clean, uncluttered interface with zero bloated dependencies.
  • Pro Extensions Available: Optional add-ons for 1-Click Direct Server-to-Server Streaming, automated offsite cloud backups (Google Drive, Dropbox, Amazon S3), and multi-site agency management available at https://wpnofuss.com.

External services

This plugin does not connect to or transmit data to external third-party services. All backup creation, file compression, and database restoration operations are executed entirely on your local WordPress server.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the minguki-site-backup-migration folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the .zip archive via WordPress Admin > Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Access the plugin via the Minguki Backup menu in the WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. Click Start Backup Now to export your site, or switch to Restore & Migrate to import an archive.
sections.faq:
Is creating site backups really 100% free?

Yes! Creating full site backups is completely free with unlimited usage. You can export as many backups as you need and download them directly to your computer.

Are backup and restore functions free?

Yes! Creating full site backups, downloading .nofusswp archives, and restoring sites using the drag-and-drop uploader or stored archive selector are completely free.

What features are included in No Fuss Backup Pro?

No Fuss Backup Pro adds 1-Click Direct Server-to-Server Streaming (zero downloading/uploading), automated offsite cloud backups (Google Drive, Dropbox, Amazon S3), multi-site agency fleet management for 5 to 55+ client sites, and priority agency support. Learn more at https://wpnofuss.com.

Does this plugin alter my serialized database data?

Yes, safely! Our engine uses a recursive unserialize-replace-serialize algorithm that recalculates PHP string lengths (s:N:), ensuring that Elementor, Gutenberg, Divi, and theme options never suffer data corruption.

How can I get support or report an issue?

We offer direct email support and a dedicated customer ticket desk:
* Direct Email: support@wpnofuss.com
* Support Ticket Desk: https://wpnofuss.com/support
* Documentation & Guides: https://wpnofuss.com/docs
sections.changelog:
1.0.6

  • Added filename-level asset cache busting (msbm-admin.js) to guarantee fresh script execution regardless of browser or reverse-proxy disk cache policies.
  • Enhanced serialized migration engine to automatically search and replace both ‘www’ and non-‘www’ domain variations.
  • Hardened background backup poller and status modal transitions during proxy connection cutoffs.

1.0.5

  • Added proxy-resilient polling and modern modal notifications for Cloudflare and reverse-proxy timeouts (HTTP 524 / 504).
  • Automatically tracks long-running large backups and restores without premature browser alert errors.

1.0.4

  • Fixed database dump string escaping to prevent WordPress 6.2+ esc_sql from converting ‘%’ characters to placeholder hashes.
  • Added automatic healing of legacy placeholder hashes on restore to recover Elementor styling, column widths, and permalinks.
  • Enhanced recursive URL search & replace to handle both http and https protocol variations across all database tables.

1.0.3

  • Fixed directory mapping when extracting themes, plugins, and uploads into wp-content.

1.0.2

  • Fixed serialized search & replace fatal error caused by protected/private object properties during domain migration.
  • Enhanced restore error reporting with detailed status messages.

1.0.1

  • Fixed file picker trigger on the Restore & Migrate upload dropzone for modern Chromium and Firefox browsers.
  • Improved dropzone click handling with direct native file selector dispatch.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release with single-file .nofusswp archive packaging, chunked MySQL database engine, and modern administrative interface.
